body.statement: When \(K=2\), \(m=1\), \(C=(-1,1)\), and \(W=(1)\), the cone condition holds and \(Y^{\uparrow}(F)\) yields exactly the comonotone sharp upper randomization-variance endpoint of Aronow, Green, and Lee.
body.justification: The reduction is the required sanity check against the canonical sharp two-arm result.
body.gap: This proposition is intentionally an equivalence check rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: Existing two-arm causal-bootstrap software becomes a verified special case of the general certificate.
